gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histopathologically proven diagnosis of glioblastoma prior to registration, by pathology report;

candidate_evidence.quote: The primary purpose of this study is to test the safety of Pembrolizumab and Temozolomide in treating recurrent glioblastoma

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Characterize the safety and immunologic/genomic/metabolomic effects of neoadjuvant Pembrolizumab and Temozolomide in recurrent glioblastoma.

role_evidence.quote: Participants will receive one cycle of Temozolomide and Pembrolizumab prior to removing recurrent tumor, followed by three weekly cycles of treatment until progression.
The patient must have completed chemoradiation with Radiotherapy and Temozolomide of the primary tumor according to standard of care.

coder_notes: Single-group trial although two arms are registered (one per drug). Pembrolizumab is the only investigational agent; temozolomide coded soc_backbone (given to all participants, established GBM drug). The neoadjuvant timing of temozolomide could be read as a new schedule (established_therapy_experiment) but the record frames pembrolizumab as the new element; candidate status of pembrolizumab is the same either way.
